title: Seven new heroes
text:
Every class gets a detailed new hero model.

✨ Bulwark: Bronthak, a spiked iron juggernaut with a skull shield and spear
✨ Celestus: Seraphielle, a winged celestial knight in white and gold
✨ Barbarian: the Last Conqueror, a scarred warlord in battered leather and plate
✨ Arcanist: Vexmortis, a plague-masked alchemist in a tattered crimson coat
✨ Shade: a hooded spectral assassin wrapped in chains and torn grey cloth
✨ Hunter: a witch hunter in a long coat and wide-brimmed hat
✨ Bard: Haldreon, a white-armoured knight crowned with a thorned halo
⬆️ Heroes walk, run, ride, swim, sit, kneel, dance and bow, twist into their attacks, lean back to cast and fall when they die. Stealthed Shades turn see-through
⬆️ The new heroes show their own sculpted weapons and armour, so your gear no longer changes how you look. To see your equipped gear on the classic figure again, turn off "Detailed hero models" in Esc > Settings
